heading: SEBI's New MF-Only PMS: A ₹25 Lakh Gateway to Managed Funds
tldr: SEBI has proposed a new category of Portfolio Management Services (PMS) that will exclusively invest in mutual funds.
This "MF-only PMS" aims to bridge the gap between direct mutual fund investing and traditional, high-net-worth PMS offerings.
The entry threshold for this new service is set at a more accessible ₹25 lakhs, significantly lower than traditional PMS.
It offers professional management of a mutual fund portfolio, potentially benefiting investors seeking expert guidance without direct stock exposure.
Investors should carefully evaluate the fee structure and the level of customisation offered compared to self-managed mutual funds.
caption:
Ever wished for expert help with your mutual funds but felt it was out of reach? Good news! SEBI is planning a new service called "MF-only PMS." It means you can get professional management for your mutual fund investments, starting with ₹25 lakhs. This could be a great way to grow your money with expert guidance, without picking stocks yourself. Learn more about how this could benefit you.
